law_name: Law No. 2016-555 of 26 July 2016 on Copyright and Related Rights
term_of_protection: Author's life + 70 years (anonymous and pseudonymous works: 70 years from end of year of lawful public availability)
moral_rights: Paternity, integrity, disclosure, withdrawal/access; perpetual, inalienable, imprescriptible (cited as Art. 47); performers' moral right Art. 82
digital_protection: Art. 108 (Title IV ch. I): rightholders may use technical measures against unauthorised use, without hindering legitimate uses; RMI article not confirmed
fair_use_exceptions: Closed list of exceptions incl. private copying (art. 24)
enforcement_body: Bureau Ivoirien du Droit d'Auteur (BURIDA), under the Ministry of Culture and Francophonie
